chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Safwan, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"The two parties to a transaction have the option of cancellation for three days in the sale of animals, and in other types of sales until they separate."

key_terms.اَلْمُتَبَايِعَانِ: The two parties to a transaction (buyer and seller)

ai.seo_question: What is the duration of the cancellation option (khiyar) in Islamic sales contracts?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), transmitted via the chain of Safwan, clarifies the duration of the option of the session (khiyar al-majlis) in commercial transactions. While general sales allow cancellation until the parties separate, the sale of animals grants a specific three-day window, reflecting the practical need for inspection and deliberation in livestock trade. This distinction underscores the Shia juristic emphasis on fairness and preventing regret in contractual agreements.
